verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair axis for a self-hostable AI email app, but the evidence documents no user-facing Zero CLI. The pnpm scripts (pnpm go, pnpm db:studio, pnpm nizzy env, pnpm eval) are repo development and setup commands, not an official CLI for operating email. The MCP server belongs to a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
